title: Which national team will win the third-place playoff at the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup?
background: The third-place playoff is contested by the two teams eliminated in the semifinals.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : FIFA's official result for the 2026 Men's World Cup third-place playoff. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the winner of the third-place playoff, scheduled for July 18, 2026, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
